title: BEAR-Bench: A Bilingual Enterprise and Academic Reasoning Benchmark for Multimodal Models
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made significant strides in visual comprehension, their ability to reason about text-dense, professional documents remains incompletely evaluated. Existing benchmarks emphasize information extraction, require external domain knowledge, or cover professional documents only as one of many settings.
